data_fetch_plan.prompt: Fetch the Survey Completion Date Time, Case NPS Score Segment, Account Name, Case Owner Name, Case NPS Feedback Comments, Case Number, and Case Invalid Survey for all survey responses from last week where the survey is not invalid.

Fetch the Survey Completion Date Time, Case NPS Score Segment, Account Name, Case Owner Name, Case Number, and Case Invalid Survey for all survey responses from the week before last where the survey is not invalid.
Fetch the Survey Completion Date Time, Case NPS Score Segment, Case Owner Name, Account Name, and Case Invalid Survey for all survey responses from the last 8 weeks where the survey is not invalid.

analysis_plan.title: Last Week's NPS Performance Analysis
analysis_plan.objective: Using the fetched data for last week, group by NPS segment, account, and case owner to count the number of responses and list feedback comments. This will identify the top detractors and passives.

aggregations: COUNT(Case Number) as Number of Responses
LIST(Case NPS Feedback Comments) as Feedback Comments

analysis_plan.key_insights_questions_answered: What was the overall performance for each NPS segment last week? For Detractors and Passives, which Case Owners and Account Names were most frequently cited? What were the specific feedback comments provided?

analysis_plan.title: Prior Week's NPS Performance Analysis
analysis_plan.objective: Using the fetched data for the prior week, group by NPS segment, account, and case owner to count the number of responses. This establishes a baseline for week-over-week comparison.

aggregations: COUNT(Case Number) as Number of Responses

analysis_plan.key_insights_questions_answered: What was the performance for each NPS segment in the prior week? How does this compare to last week's performance? Are there recurring issues or improvements?

analysis_plan.title: Last 8-Week Average NPS Performance
analysis_plan.objective: Using the fetched data from the last 8 weeks, first calculate the weekly response count for each NPS segment. Then, compute the average of these weekly counts for each segment to establish a historical benchmark.

group_by: Week of Survey Completion Date Time
aggregations: COUNT(Case Number) as Weekly Response Count
After computing weekly counts, calculate AVERAGE(Weekly Response Count) grouped by Case NPS Score Segment

analysis_plan.key_insights_questions_answered: What is the average weekly number of Promoters, Detractors, and Passives over the last 8 weeks? This provides a baseline to measure weekly performance against.

analysis_plan.title: Comparative Analysis: Last Week vs. 8-Week Average
analysis_plan.objective: Compare the results from Step 1 (Total Last Week Responses) with the results from Step 3 (Average 8 Week Responses) for each NPS segment to identify significant deviations and trends.

aggregations: SUM(Number of Responses from step 1) as Total Last Week Responses
CALCULATE VARIANCE(Total Last Week Responses, Average 8 Week Responses)

analysis_plan.key_insights_questions_answered: How did the number of Promoters, Detractors, and Passives last week compare to the trailing 8-week average? Is our customer experience trending in the right direction? Where should we focus our efforts for improvement?
